auth.title: Sign in to Dymcode
auth.sent: Check your inbox for a sign-in link.
auth.sendFailed: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a minute.
auth.callbackFailed: That sign-in link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

projects.name: Project name
projects.siteUrlHint: Used to restrict where the widget can send feedback from.
projects.nameInvalid: Enter a name from 1 to 80 characters.
projects.limitReached: The Free plan includes one project. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited projects.

install.title: Install the widget
install.intro: Paste this snippet before the closing </body> tag of your site.
install.nextjsHint: Use next/script with strategy "afterInteractive" in your root layout.
install.customHint: Add data-hide-trigger and call Dymcode.open('bug') from your UI.
install.identifyHint: Call Dymcode.identify({ email, id, name }) after sign-in.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.hidden: {count, plural, one {# hidden report} other {# hidden reports}} over your Free limit. Upgrade to see them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Project name
settings.originsHint: One per line. Leave empty to accept feedback from any site.
settings.originInvalid: One of the websites is not a valid address.
settings.tooManyOrigins: You can list up to 20 websites.
settings.originsTooLong: The list of allowed websites is too long (max 4 096 bytes).
settings.cssTooLarge: Custom CSS must be at most 10 240 bytes.
